   242	    divisorVal K (D := D) (W := W) s = (s : X.functionField) := rfl
   243

   245	    (s : (divisorPresheaf K D).obj (op W)) : divisorVal K s ∈ divisorSections K D W :=

   248	/-- The underlying function-field value of a restricted section (nonempty target) is unchanged. -/
   249	lemma divisorPresheaf_map_val {D : X.CurveDivisor} {U V : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V)
   250	    (hV : (V.unop : Set X).Nonempty) (s : (divisorPresheaf K D).obj U) :
   251	    divisorVal K ((divisorPresheaf K D).map i s) = divisorVal K s :=
   252	  divisorSectionsRes_coe K (leOfHom i.unop) hV s
   253	
   254	/-- Two sections of `𝒪(D)` over the same open agreeing as rational functions are equal. -/
   255	lemma divisorSection_ext {D : X.CurveDivisor} {W : X.Opens}
   256	    {a b : (divisorPresheaf K D).obj (op W)} (h : divisorVal K a = divisorVal K b) : a = b :=
   257	  Subtype.ext h
   258	
   259	/-- Sections of `𝒪(D)` over an empty open form a subsingleton. -/
   260	lemma divisorPresheaf_obj_subsingleton {D : X.CurveDivisor} {W : X.Opens}
   261	    (hW : ¬ (W : Set X).Nonempty) :
   262	    Subsingleton (ToType ((divisorPresheaf K D).obj (op W))) :=
   263	  divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hW
   264	
   265	/-- **Two nonempty opens of an irreducible space meet.** -/
   266	lemma opens_inf_nonempty {U V : X.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty)
   267	    (hV : (V : Set X).Nonempty) : (↑(U ⊓ V) : Set X).Nonempty := by
   268	  rw [Opens.coe_inf]
   269	  have h := PreirreducibleSpace.isPreirreducible_univ (↑U : Set X) (↑V : Set X) U.isOpen V.isOpen
   270	    (by simpa using hU) (by simpa using hV)
   271	  simpa using h
   272	
   273	/-- **The presheaf `𝒪(D)` is a sheaf.** On the irreducible space `X` a compatible family of
   274	sections over a cover shares a single underlying rational function (any two nonempty members
   275	agree, since their opens meet), which then satisfies the pole bound at every point of the union;
   276	over the empty open all sections are terminal. -/
   277	lemma isSheaf_divisorPresheaf (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   278	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X : TopCat)) (divisorPresheaf K D) := by
   279	  have hsh : TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf (divisorPresheaf K D) := by
   280	    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
   281	    intro ι U sf hcompat
   282	    have hval : ∀ i j, (U i : Set X).Nonempty → (U j : Set X).Nonempty →
   283	        divisorVal K (sf i) = divisorVal K (sf j) := by
   284	      intro i j hi hj
   285	      have hmeet := opens_inf_nonempty hi hj
   286	      have e1 := divisorPresheaf_map_val K (Opens.infLELeft (U i) (U j)).op hmeet (sf i)
   287	      have e2 := divisorPresheaf_map_val K (Opens.infLERight (U i) (U j)).op hmeet (sf j)
   288	      rw [← e1, ← e2, hcompat i j]
   289	    by_cases hsup : (↑(iSup U) : Set X).Nonempty
   290	    · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ : ∃ i₀, (U i₀ : Set X).Nonempty := by
   291	        rw [Opens.coe_iSup] at hsup
   292	        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsup
   293	        obtain ⟨i₀, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
   294	        exact ⟨i₀, ⟨x, hxi⟩⟩
   295	      have hg₀ : divisorVal K (sf i₀) ∈ divisorSections K D (iSup U) := by
   296	        rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K hsup]
   297	        intro x hx hxmem
   298	        obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxmem
   299	        have hjne : (U j : Set X).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxj⟩
   300	        rw [hval i₀ j hi₀ hjne]

150	      change F + Finsupp.single p 1 - Finsupp.single p 1 = F
   151	      abel
   152	    rw [heq]
   153	  exact h.trans h2
   154	
   155	/-- Adding the point back: `(D − x) + x = D` for the dévissage twist. -/
   156	lemma devissageDivisor_add_single {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   157	    devissageDivisor hx D + CurveDivisor.single hx 1 = D := by
   158	  rw [devissageDivisor_eq_sub]
   159	  abel
   160	
   161	/-- The degree drops by the residue degree along the dévissage twist:
   162	`deg (D − x) = deg D − [κ(x) : K]`. -/
   163	lemma deg_devissageDivisor (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   164	    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   165	    CurveDivisor.deg K (devissageDivisor hx D) =
   166	      CurveDivisor.deg K D - X.residueDeg K x := by
   167	  have h := CurveDivisor.deg_add K (devissageDivisor hx D) (CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   168	  rw [devissageDivisor_add_single hx D] at h
   169	  have hsingle : CurveDivisor.deg K (CurveDivisor.single hx 1) = X.residueDeg K x := by
   170	    have h1 := CurveDivisor.deg_single K (X := X)
   171	      (⟨x, hx⟩ : {p : X // p ≠ genericPoint X}) 1
   172	    rw [one_mul] at h1
   173	    exact h1
   174	  rw [hsingle] at h
   175	  omega
   176	
   177	end Scaffolding

   179	/-! ## The cohomology of a skyscraper is finite -/
   180	
   181	section Skyscraper
   182	
   183	variable {K : Type u} [CommRing K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   184	
   185	/-- `H⁰` of a skyscraper sheaf with finite value module is a finite `K`-module
   186	(transport of the value module along `skyModuleGammaEquiv`). -/
   187	theorem moduleFinite_hModule_skyModule_zero (x : X) (M : ModuleCat.{u} K)
   188	    [Module.Finite K M] :
   189	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (skyModule x M) 0) :=
   190	  Module.Finite.equiv (skyModuleGammaEquiv x M).symm
   191	
   192	/-- `H¹` of a skyscraper sheaf is a finite `K`-module (it vanishes). -/
   193	theorem moduleFinite_hModule_skyModule_one (x : X) (M : ModuleCat.{u} K) :
   194	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (skyModule x M) 1) :=
   195	  haveI : Finite (Sheaf.HModule (skyModule x M) 1) := Finite.of_subsingleton
   196	  Module.Finite.of_finite
   197	
   198	end Skyscraper

   200	/-! ## Finiteness dévissage for divisor sheaves -/
   201	
   202	section Devissage
   203	
   204	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   205	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
   206	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   207	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
   208	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
   209	
   210	private theorem moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_aux (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   211	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K D) 0) ∧
   212	      Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K D) 1) := by
   213	  refine Scheme.CurveDivisor.induction_devissage
   214	    (P := fun D => Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K D) 0) ∧
   215	      Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K D) 1))
   216	    ⟨?_, ?_⟩ (fun {x} hx D => ?_) D
   217	  · exact Module.Finite.equiv (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (moduleKSheafDivisorSheafZeroIso K) 0)
   218	  · exact Module.Finite.equiv (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (moduleKSheafDivisorSheafZeroIso K) 1)
   219	  · -- the dévissage step, both ways, through the six-term slice
   220	    have hS := devissageSES_shortExact K hx D
   221	    -- the skyscraper term of the slice, in the `devissageSES` spelling
   222	    haveI hsky0 : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₃ 0) :=
   223	      haveI := moduleFinite_jumpModule K hx D
   224	      moduleFinite_hModule_skyModule_zero x (jumpModule K hx D)
   225	    haveI hsky1 : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₃ 1) :=
   226	      moduleFinite_hModule_skyModule_one x (jumpModule K hx D)
   227	    haveI hskysub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₃ 1) :=
   228	      skyModule_subsingleton_hModule_one x (jumpModule K hx D)
   229	    constructor
   230	    · rintro ⟨h0D, h1D⟩
   231	      haveI hX₂0 : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₂ 0) := h0D
   232	      haveI hX₂1 : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₂ 1) := h1D
   233	      exact ⟨Sheaf.HModule.moduleFinite_left_zero hS,
   234	        Sheaf.HModule.moduleFinite_left_succ hS (show 0 + 1 = 1 from rfl)⟩
   235	    · rintro ⟨h0D', h1D'⟩
   236	      haveI hX₁0 : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₁ 0) := h0D'
   237	      haveI hX₁1 : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (devissageSES K hx D).X₁ 1) := h1D'
   238	      exact ⟨Sheaf.HModule.moduleFinite_middle hS 0, Sheaf.HModule.moduleFinite_middle hS 1⟩
   239	
   240	/-- **Finiteness of `H⁰(𝒪(D))`** for every Weil divisor `D` on the curve bundle `X`, by
   241	dévissage from the structure sheaf (whose `H⁰`/`H¹` finiteness are the two instance
   242	hypotheses — properness enters only through them). -/
   243	instance moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_zero (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   244	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K D) 0) :=
   245	  (moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_aux K D).1
   246	
   247	/-- **Finiteness of `H¹(𝒪(D))`** for every Weil divisor `D` on the curve bundle `X`, by
   248	dévissage from the structure sheaf (whose `H⁰`/`H¹` finiteness are the two instance
   249	hypotheses — properness enters only through them). -/
   250	instance moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_one (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   251	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K D) 1) :=
   252	  (moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_aux K D).2
   253	
   254	end Devissage

    12	/-!
    13	# Degree-one affine vanishing for quasi-coherent modules and Čech cover-independence
    14	
    15	The wave-5 keystone of the B3 lane: the degree-one affine vanishing
    16	`H¹(U, M) = 0` (`HModule'`-form) for every affine open `U` and every
    17	**quasi-coherent** sheaf of modules `M` on a `Spec k`-scheme, and the resulting
    18	Čech **cover-independence** of `Ȟ¹`-vanishing on 2-affine covers.
    19	
    20	## The bridge
    21	
    22	The `HModule'` derived-functor machinery
    23	(`Cohomology/StructureSheafModuleK/*`, `RiemannRoch/Adelic/GenusUnconditional`)
    24	runs on sheaves of `k`-modules on the opens site; the B3 consumers work with
    25	`X.Modules` (sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules).  `toModuleKSheafOfModules` is the
    26	dialect bridge: the underlying additive sheaf of `M : C.left.Modules`, with the
    27	`k`-action restricted along the structure morphism (mirroring `toModuleKSheaf`
    28	for the structure sheaf itself).  Sections, restriction maps and hence all
    29	Čech difference maps agree **definitionally** with those of `M`.
    30	
    31	## The vanishing
    32	
    33	`subsingleton_hModule'_one_of_isAffineOpen_of_isQuasicoherent` mirrors the
    34	structure-sheaf proof `subsingleton_hModule'_one_toModuleKSheaf_of_isAffineOpen`
    35	(`AffineDegreeOneVanishing.lean`) step by step; the single 𝒪-specific brick —
    36	sections of the kernel over the basic opens `D(g_σ)` are the localisations
    37	`Γ(M, U)_{g_σ}` — is replaced by the quasi-coherence keystone
    38	`Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen` (Stacks 01HV(4)/01I8 at
    39	affine-open generality, `Picard/QuotScheme.lean`), packaged here as the module
    40	section-identification kit `IsAffineOpen.dCoeffModuleSectionsLinearEquiv`
    41	(mirroring `IsAffineOpen.dCoeffSectionsLinearEquiv` of
    42	`CechCoboundarySplitting.lean`).
    43	
    44	## Cover-independence
    45	
    46	With degree-1 vanishing on the two affine pieces of **every** 2-affine cover
    47	`S`, the Mayer–Vietoris `(0,1)`-slice
    48	(`AffineCoverMVSquare.hModuleOneEquivH1CokOfSubsingleton`,
    49	`GenusUnconditional.lean`) identifies the concrete two-chart Čech cokernel
    50	`S.H1Cok` with the cover-free `HModule k _ 1` — for every `S` at once.
    51	Composing two such identifications makes `Ȟ¹`-vanishing (equivalently,
    52	surjectivity of the difference-of-restrictions map) independent of the chosen
    53	cover (`AffineCoverMVSquare.surjective_moduleSectionDiff_of_surjective`), and
    54	the fibre wrapper `Scheme.Hom.FiberH1Vanishing.surjective_moduleSectionDiff`
    55	turns the ∃-form `FiberH1Vanishing` hypothesis of the pinned B3 statement into
    56	the surjectivity witness on any prescribed cover of the fibre curve — the
    57	`hindep` obligation of
    58	`fiberH1Vanishing_pushforward_finiteMapToP1BaseChange_of_coverIndependence`
    59	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`).
    60	
    61	Sources: Stacks 01XB (degree 1), 01EW (the Čech splitting), 01HV(4)/01I8
    62	(quasi-coherent sections localise); Hartshorne III.2.7, III.4.5; Leray's
    63	theorem for 2-covers with `H¹`-acyclic pieces.
    64	-/
    65	
    66	set_option autoImplicit false
    67	
    68	universe u
    69	
    70	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry Opposite
    71	
    72	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    73	
    74	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    75	
    76	/-! ## The dialect bridge: the sheaf of `k`-modules underlying an `𝒪`-module
    77	
    78	For a `Spec k`-scheme `C` and `M : C.left.Modules`, the sections `Γ(M, U)` are
    79	modules over `Γ(C.left, U)`, hence `k`-modules by restriction along the
    80	structure-morphism algebra map `k → Γ(C.left, U)`
    81	(`toModuleKSheaf.algebraSection`).  Restriction maps are `k`-linear because
    82	they are semilinear over the (algebra-map-preserving) ring restrictions.  This
    83	mirrors `toModuleKPresheaf`/`toModuleKSheaf` with the structure sheaf replaced
    84	by `M`. -/
    85	
    86	/-- The `k`-module structure on the sections of a sheaf of modules on a
    87	`Spec k`-scheme: restriction of the native `Γ(C.left, U)`-module structure
    88	along the structure-morphism algebra map.  A `@[reducible] def` registered as
    89	a local instance in this file (mirrors the discipline of
    90	`Scheme.Hom.fiberSectionsModule`). -/
    91	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    92	    (M : C.left.Modules) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat) :
    93	    Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    94	  Module.compHom _ (algebraMap k Γ(C.left, U))
    95	
    96	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    97	
    98	/-- The native `Γ(C.left, W)`-scalar action on `Γ(M, W)`, packaged as a
    99	function whose binders carry the section-notation types (so that the `•`
   100	elaborates against the `Γ`-spelled `Module` instance regardless of the
   101	spelling of the argument terms). -/
   102	private noncomputable def smulSection (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : C.left.Modules)
   103	    (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)
   104	    (s : Γ(C.left, W)) (z : Γ(M, W)) : Γ(M, W) :=
   105	  s • z
   106	
   107	/-- The underlying additive presheaf of `M : C.left.Modules` as a presheaf of
   108	`k`-modules (`toModuleKPresheaf` with the structure sheaf replaced by `M`):
   109	objects are the section groups with the `moduleKSections` `k`-action, maps are
   110	the restriction maps of `M`. -/
   111	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   112	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   113	    (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
   114	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
   115	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
   116	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
   117	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
   118	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
   119	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (algebraMap k Γ(C.left, U.unop) r) x).trans
   120	          (congrArg
   121	            (fun (s : Γ(C.left, V.unop)) =>
   122	              smulSection C M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map (f.unop).op x))
   123	            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.toModuleKSheaf.algebraMap_naturality (C := C) f r)) }
   124	  map_id U := by
   125	    ext x
   126	    simp only [ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
   127	      ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq]
   128	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (φ : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
   129	      (ConcreteCategory.hom φ : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
   130	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
   131	    ext x
   132	    simp only [ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
   133	      ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
   134	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (φ : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
   135	      (ConcreteCategory.hom φ : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
   136	
   137	/-- The presheaf of `k`-modules of `toModuleKPresheafOfModules` is a sheaf:
   138	its underlying type-valued presheaf is that of the (sheaf) `M`. -/
   139	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   140	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   141	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology C.left.toTopCat)
   142	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules C M) := by
   143	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
   144	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
   145	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
   146	
   147	/-- **The dialect bridge**: a sheaf of `𝒪`-modules on a `Spec k`-scheme,
   148	viewed as a sheaf of `k`-modules (`toModuleKSheaf` with the structure sheaf
   149	replaced by `M`).  Sections and restriction maps agree definitionally with
   150	those of `M`. -/
   151	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
   152	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   153	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology C.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
   154	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules C M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf C M⟩
   155	
   156	/-- Restriction maps of `toModuleKSheafOfModules C M` are the restriction maps
   157	of `M` on elements.  Definitional. -/
   158	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
   159	    (M : C.left.Modules) {V W : TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat} (h : W ≤ V)
   160	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules C M).obj.obj (Opposite.op V)) :
   161	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules C M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x
   162	      = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
   163	  rfl
   164	
   165	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

   167	/-! ## The quasi-coherent Čech section-identification kit
   168	
   169	The module analogue of the structure-sheaf kit of
   170	`CechCoboundarySplitting.lean` (`IsAffineOpen.dCoeffSectionsLinearEquiv` and
   171	its `dCoface` compatibility): over an affine open `U`, the abstract localised
   172	Čech coefficient `SectionCechModule.dCoeff g Γ(M, U) σ = Γ(M, U)_{g_σ}` of a
   173	**quasi-coherent** `M : X.Modules` is `Γ(X, U)`-linearly the honest section
   174	module `Γ(M, D(g_σ))`, with the Čech coface identified with the presheaf
   175	restriction of `M`.  The quasi-coherence input is the gap2 keystone
   176	`Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen` (Stacks 01HV(4)/01I8,
   177	`Picard/QuotScheme.lean`).
   178	
   179	The `Γ(X, U)`-module structure on `Γ(M, D(f))` is `Module.compHom` along the
   180	canonical algebra map `Γ(X, U) → Γ(X, D(f))` (the presheaf restriction),
   181	carried as a `letI` in each statement — the caller-supplied-instance
   182	discipline of `restrictBasicOpenₗ`. -/
   183	
   184	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
   185	
   186	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
   187	
   188	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens}
   189	
   190	/-- Double restriction of sections of a sheaf of modules collapses to the
   191	single restriction (the `M.presheaf` analogue of
   192	`map_homOfLE_map_homOfLE_apply`). -/
   193	lemma Scheme.Modules.map_homOfLE_map_homOfLE_apply (M : X.Modules)
   194	    {V W Z : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (hWZ : W ≤ Z) (z : Γ(M, Z)) :
   195	    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWZ).op z)
   196	      = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW.trans hWZ)).op z := by
   197	  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

    23	/-!
    24	# The relative Picard functor and its étale sheafification
    25	
    26	For a smooth proper geometrically integral curve `C` over a field `k`, this file upgrades
    27	the set-valued relative Picard presheaf
    28	`Pic^♯_{C/k}(T) := Pic(C ×_k T) / π_T^* Pic(T)` of
    29	`AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/LineBundlePullback.lean` to an abelian-group-valued functor, and
    30	then sheafifies it.  It feeds the positive-genus arm of `nonempty_jacobianWitness`.
    31	
    32	## Main definitions
    33	
    34	* `PicSharp.addCommGroup` — the abelian-group structure on
    35	  `Quotient (RelPicPresheaf.preimage_subgroup πC πT)`: addition is the descent of the
    36	  tensor product, `[L] + [L'] := [L ⊗ L']`, the zero is the class of the structure sheaf,
    37	  and `-[L]` is the class of the tensor inverse of `L`.
    38	* `relPicRel`, `relPicSetoid`, `PicSharp.addCommGroup_via_tensorObj` — the coarser
    39	  `H_T`-coset relation, the setoid it defines, and the abelian group on its quotient.
    40	* `PicSharp`, `PicSharp.functorial`, `PicSharp.presheaf` — the group-valued functor
    41	  `(Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat`, `T ↦ Pic(C ×_k T)`, with morphism action `g ↦ g^♯`
    42	  descended from the line-bundle pullback `g_C^* = (id_C ×_k g)^*`.
    43	* `PicSharp.relFunctorial`, `PicSharp.relPresheaf`, `PicSharp.toRelPresheaf` — the same
    44	  functor on the `H_T`-coset carrier, and the natural quotient comparison from the
    45	  absolute functor onto it.
    46	* `PicSharp.etSheaf`, `PicSharp.etSheaf_group_structure` — the sheafification of
    47	  `PicSharp.presheaf` for a Grothendieck topology `J` on `Over (Spec k)`, and its unit.
    48	
    49	## Two carriers: absolute and relative
    50	
    51	The setoid `RelPicPresheaf.preimage_subgroup` is the **iso-class** relation
    52	`Nonempty (L.carrier ≅ L'.carrier)`, so `Quotient (RelPicPresheaf.preimage_subgroup πC πT)`
    53	is the *absolute* Picard group `Pic(C ×_S T)` and `PicSharp` is the absolute functor — the
    54	additive mirror of `picCommGroup`.  The *relative* functor of Kleiman `df:Pfs` lives on the
    55	coarser carrier `Quotient (relPicSetoid πC πT) = Pic(C ×_S T) / π_T^* Pic(T)`; it is
    56	`relPresheaf`, and `toRelPresheaf` is the comparison from the absolute functor.
    57	
    58	The blueprint pins (`def:rel_pic_sharp` and friends) still name the absolute functor;
    59	repinning them to the relative carrier is a coordinated blueprint change.  Likewise
    60	`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean` still uses its own opaque `Type u`-valued `picSharp`
    61	placeholder; rewiring it to the functor built here needs a universe bump
    62	(`Type u → Type (u + 1)` in `HasPicScheme` and downstream) and must target the
    63	étale-sheafified *relative* functor — wiring it to the absolute `PicSharp` would make
    64	`PicSharpRepresentable` a mathematically false statement.
    65	
    66	## The `H_T`-coset relation
    67	
    68	For `L L' : LineBundle.OnProduct πC πT`, `relPicRel` is taken in the multiplicative form
    69	```
    70	L ~ L'   ↔   ∃ N locally trivial on T,  L.carrier ≅ π_T^* N ⊗ L'.carrier,
    71	```
    72	the left-coset relation of `H_T := im π_T^*`.  It is equivalent to the blueprint's
    73	`L ⊗ L'⁻¹ ≅ π_T^* N`, but avoids naming the tensor inverse of `L'` in the *definition*;
    74	only the symmetry proof consumes a tensor inverse, that of `N` on the base `T`.
    75	
    76	## The topology parameter
    77	
    78	Mathlib does not provide an étale Grothendieck topology on schemes (only the morphism
    79	property `AlgebraicGeometry.Etale`), so `PicSharp.etSheaf` takes the topology
    80	`J : GrothendieckTopology (Over (Spec k))` as a parameter, to be specialised to the
    81	canonical étale topology once that is available.  Sheafifying is not cosmetic:
    82	`Pic^♯_{C/k}` is in general not representable (Kleiman L5105–L5108; see the §5
    83	note below, and do **not** restore the older "not even a Zariski sheaf" reason,
    84	which no source supports for the *relative* functor).
    85	
    86	## References
    87	
    88	Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_RelPicFunctor.tex`.
    89	Source: [Kleiman], "The Picard scheme", §2 (FGA Explained
    90	Ch.9 §9.2), Definitions `df:aPf` (absolute Picard functor) +
    91	`df:Pfs` (relative Picard functor, including the étale-sheafified form
    92	`Pic_{(X/S)ét}`); Stacks Project tag 01CR (abelian-group structure on
    93	the Picard group via tensor product).
    94	-/

   124	/-! ## §1. Abelian-group structure on the relative Picard quotient
   125	
   126	The Picard group `Pic(X)` of any scheme is canonically an abelian group
   127	under tensor product of line bundles (Stacks tag 01CR; the inverse of
   128	`[L]` is `[L⁻¹] = [Hom_{O_X}(L, O_X)]`). The pullback map
   129	`π_T^* : Pic(T) → Pic(C ×_k T)` of
   130	`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle.pullbackAlongProjection`
   131	respects this structure: it sends `O_T ↦ O_{C ×_k T}` (the structure
   132	sheaf is preserved by inverse image) and is multiplicative on tensor
   133	products (Stacks 01HH for invertibility, Mathlib's

   300	/-! ## §1b. The relative Picard `H_T`-coset setoid
   301	
   302	`PicSharp.addCommGroup` lives on `Quotient (RelPicPresheaf.preimage_subgroup πC πT)`,
   303	whose carrier setoid is the **iso-class** relation `Nonempty (L.carrier ≅ L'.carrier)` — i.e. the
   304	**absolute** `Pic(C ×_S T)`. The blueprint (`lem:rel_pic_sharp_groupoid`, Kleiman §2 `df:Pfs`) asks

   306	`H_T := im π_T^*`. This section builds that quotient directly as a coarser setoid

   308	`PicSharp.addCommGroup_via_tensorObj` on it.

   310	**Relation (multiplicative form).** For `L L' : OnProduct πC πT` set
   311	```

   313	```

   315	relation of `H_T := im π_T^*`. It is **equivalent** to the blueprint's `L ⊗ L'^{-1} ≅ π_T^* N`

events.text: A second route is cleaner than the divisor short-exact-sequence proof: the project already has unconditional Čech-to-derived comparison for quasicoherent modules on two-affine covers. A theorem identifying `Sheaf.chi` with the signed kernel/cokernel dimension of `moduleSectionDiff` would directly connect the scheme fibre index to the two-term algebra from Round 4, with no new gate. I’m checking whether that equality already exists and whether both comparison equivalences are available under current imports.

   831	cover `W` of `X_t`.  The fibre is a scheme over the residue field `κ(t)` via

   833	(`AffineCoverMVSquare.surjective_moduleSectionDiff_of_surjective`) applies
   834	over that field. -/

   122	/-! ## §1. Degree-1 Čech vocabulary for 𝒪-modules on a 2-affine cover
   123	
   124	The adelic lane (`RiemannRoch/Adelic/Cokernel.lean`) works with sheaves of
   125	`k`-modules; the Picard lane works with `X.Modules`.  The following is the
   126	`X.Modules` dialect of the lane's `sectionDiff`/`H1Cok`/`sectionGlue` kit on
   127	a bundled 2-affine cover (`AffineCoverMVSquare`).  Restriction maps of a
   128	sheaf of modules are only *semilinear* over the restriction of scalars, so
   129	the natural home of the difference map is additive homs. -/
   130	
   131	variable {X S : Scheme.{u}}
   132	
   133	/-- The **difference-of-restrictions map** of a 2-affine cover for a sheaf of
   134	`𝒪_X`-modules `M`: the additive map
   135	`Γ(U₁, M) × Γ(U₂, M) →+ Γ(U₁ ⊓ U₂, M)`, `(a, b) ↦ a|_{U₁⊓U₂} − b|_{U₁⊓U₂}`.
   136	Its cokernel is the concrete Čech `Ȟ¹(𝒰, M)` of the cover
   137	(`AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleH1Cok`), its kernel the glued global sections.
   138	`X.Modules`-dialect of `AffineCoverMVSquare.sectionDiff`
   139	(`RiemannRoch/Adelic/Cokernel.lean`). -/
   140	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   141	    (M : X.Modules) :
   142	    Γ(M, V.U₁) × Γ(M, V.U₂) →+ Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) :=
   143	  ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁)).op).hom.comp
   144	      (AddMonoidHom.fst _ _)) -
   145	    ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂)).op).hom.comp
   146	      (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _))
   147	
   148	/-- The value of the difference map. -/
   149	lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_apply (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   150	    (M : X.Modules) (p : Γ(M, V.U₁) × Γ(M, V.U₂)) :
   151	    V.moduleSectionDiff M p =
   152	      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁)).op).hom p.1 -
   153	        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂)).op).hom p.2 :=
   154	  rfl
   155	
   156	/-- **The concrete Čech `Ȟ¹` of a 2-affine cover, `X.Modules` dialect**: the
   157	cokernel `Γ(U₁ ⊓ U₂, M) ⧸ im(Γ(U₁, M) × Γ(U₂, M))` of the
   158	difference-of-restrictions map, as an abelian group.  For quasi-coherent `M`
   159	on a separated scheme this computes sheaf `H¹(X, M)` (Mayer–Vietoris on the
   160	affine 2-cover; in-lane precedent `hModuleOne_linearEquiv_cechCohomology`).
   161	`X.Modules`-dialect of `AffineCoverMVSquare.H1Cok`. -/
   162	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleH1Cok (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   163	    (M : X.Modules) : Type u :=
   164	  Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) ⧸ (V.moduleSectionDiff M).range
   165

   167	    AddCommGroup (V.moduleH1Cok M) :=
   168	  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup (_ ⧸ (V.moduleSectionDiff M).range))

   176	  · intro h c
   177	    have hc : (QuotientAddGroup.mk c : V.moduleH1Cok M) = QuotientAddGroup.mk 0 :=

   179	    rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq] at hc
   180	    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hc
   181	    refine ⟨-p, ?_⟩
   182	    have : -(V.moduleSectionDiff M p) = c := by
   183	      rw [hp]; abel
   184	    simpa [map_neg] using this
   185	  · intro h
   186	    have hrange : (V.moduleSectionDiff M).range = ⊤ :=
   187	      AddMonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr h
   188	    change Subsingleton (Γ(M, V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂) ⧸ (V.moduleSectionDiff M).range)
   189	    rw [hrange]
   190	    exact QuotientAddGroup.subsingleton_quotient_top

   197	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionRes (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   198	    (M : X.Modules) :
   199	    Γ(M, (⊤ : X.Opens)) →+ Γ(M, V.U₁) × Γ(M, V.U₂) :=
   200	  ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₁ ≤ ⊤)).op).hom).prod

   202

   204	`Γ(M) → Γ(U₁, M) × Γ(U₂, M) → Γ(U₁ ⊓ U₂, M)` vanishes — restrictions of a

   208	    (V : X.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : X.Modules) :
   209	    (V.moduleSectionDiff M).comp (V.moduleSectionRes M) = 0 := by
   210	  ext s
   211	  have h₁ : (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁)).op).hom
   212	        ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₁ ≤ ⊤)).op).hom s) =
   213	      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ ⊤)).op).hom s := by
   214	    have := M.presheaf.map_comp (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₁ ≤ ⊤)).op
   215	      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₁)).op
   216	    exact (congrArg (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) s) this.symm).trans rfl
   217	  have h₂ : (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂)).op).hom
   218	        ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₂ ≤ ⊤)).op).hom s) =
   219	      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ ⊤)).op).hom s := by
   220	    have := M.presheaf.map_comp (homOfLE (le_top : V.U₂ ≤ ⊤)).op
   221	      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V.U₁ ⊓ V.U₂ ≤ V.U₂)).op
   222	    exact (congrArg (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) s) this.symm).trans rfl
   223	  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply,
   224	    moduleSectionDiff_apply, moduleSectionRes, AddMonoidHom.prod_apply]

   226

   228	`f : X ⟶ Y` affine and a bundled 2-affine cover of `Y`, the preimages of the

   183	section CechKit

   186	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))

   188	/-- **The difference-of-restrictions map, `k`-linear form**: the base-ring
   189	linear upgrade of `AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff`
   190	(`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`) for a sheaf of modules `M` on a `k`-scheme

   195	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.sectionDiffₗ (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)

   207	        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂ ≤ S.U₂)).op).hom p.2 :=

   211	`AddMonoidHom`-level `moduleSectionDiff`; this is what transports every

   215	    ⇑(S.sectionDiffₗ C M) = ⇑(S.moduleSectionDiff M) :=
   216	  rfl

   219	difference map — pairs of sections agreeing on the overlap.  By the sheaf
   220	condition this is the global sections (`globalSectionsEquivH0ₗ`), which is

   222	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.H0ₗ (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)

   232	    (M : C.left.Modules) : Type u :=
   233	  BaseSections C M (S.U₁ ⊓ S.U₂) ⧸ LinearMap.range (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)
   234	
   235	noncomputable instance (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : C.left.Modules) :
   236	    AddCommGroup (S.H1Cokₗ C M) :=
   237	  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup (_ ⧸ LinearMap.range (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)))
   238	
   239	noncomputable instance (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : C.left.Modules) :
   240	    Module k (S.H1Cokₗ C M) :=
   241	  inferInstanceAs (Module k (_ ⧸ LinearMap.range (S.sectionDiffₗ C M)))
   242

   244	difference map (junk value `0` when infinite-dimensional; finiteness for
   245	general coherent `M` is a later P2 wave). -/
   246	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.h0 (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   247	    (M : C.left.Modules) : ℕ :=
   248	  Module.finrank k (S.H0ₗ C M)
   249	
   250	/-- **`h¹(M)` on the cover `S`**: the `k`-dimension of the concrete Čech
   251	cokernel (junk value `0` when infinite-dimensional). -/
   252	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.h1 (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   253	    (M : C.left.Modules) : ℕ :=
   254	  Module.finrank k (S.H1Cokₗ C M)
   255	
   256	/-- **The Euler characteristic `χ(M) = h⁰(M) − h¹(M)` on the cover `S`.**
   257	It agrees with the sheaf-theoretic `χ` whenever both `h⁰` and `h¹` are finite
   258	and the cover computes them, which for the curves considered here is every
   259	2-affine cover. -/
   260	noncomputable def AffineCoverMVSquare.chi (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   261	    (M : C.left.Modules) : ℤ :=
   262	  (S.h0 C M : ℤ) - (S.h1 C M : ℤ)
   263	
   264	lemma AffineCoverMVSquare.chi_def (S : C.left.AffineCoverMVSquare)
   265	    (M : C.left.Modules) :
   266	    S.chi C M = (S.h0 C M : ℤ) - (S.h1 C M : ℤ) :=
   267	  rfl
